items.change: Added an ESLint 9 flat configuration with the existing plugin rules and build-artifact ignores, and updated the root ESLint tooling to support it.
Changed TypeScript module resolution from node to bundler, changed JSX compilation from preserve to react-jsx, and included Next's generated development route types.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16's updated TypeScript and generated route-type setup.

items.change: Changed the generated route-types import from .next/types/routes.d.ts to .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16's changed location for development-generated route types.

items.change: Enabled the React Compiler with reactCompiler: true.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16's support for enabling the React Compiler.

items.change: Changed the generated route-types import back from .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts to .next/types/routes.d.ts.
items.responds_to: The Next.js 16 build-time location of the generated route types.
Next.js 16 generating the environment and route-type declarations instead of requiring this file to remain tracked.

items.change: Added packages/web/next-env.d.ts to the ignored files.
items.responds_to: The Next.js-generated next-env.d.ts file no longer being maintained as a tracked source file.

items.change: Added documentation describing the Next.js 16 upgrade, ESLint flat-config migration, compatibility checks, test/build results, and Next.js 16 features now available.
items.responds_to: The completed Next.js 15-to-16 migration and its associated configuration changes.
